The Indian Women’s Hockey Team put up a spirited fight against the Netherlands in their Round 2 clash of the FIH Hockey World Cup Belgium & Netherlands 2026, going down 0–2 in a hard-fought encounter.
India battled till the final whistle against a strong Dutch side, while the Netherlands secured their place in the semifinals with the victory.
Watch the highlights from an intense India vs Netherlands clash as the Indian Women’s Team gave it their all on the pitch!
